roles.name: Public-space operator
qualifications: licensed landscape or public-space operator with liability coverage
authority: open or close pilot sections of the public-space component library
trigger the switchback rollback path for public-space capabilities
roles.absence_prohibition: pilot sections must fall back to fixed wayfinding, always-on lighting and staffed service; no AI-only section may stay open

roles.name: Test-safety lead
qualifications: AI safety evaluation experience with reproducible test records
authority: approve or reject sandbox test plans and reports
roles.absence_prohibition: the safety-governance sandbox must not accept new test batches

roles.name: Service operations lead
qualifications: legal and copyright review channel on call
authority: publish or withdraw open-source release-hall content
roles.absence_prohibition: no new release-hall content may be published; disputed items stay withdrawn

roles.name: Community care lead
authority: operate the staffed service desk and paper reporting channel
switch AI living-service street back to the manual channel
roles.absence_prohibition: the AI living-service street must switch to the staffed desk and paper channel

roles.name: Culture venue operator
authority: display or withdraw cultural and heritage content
roles.absence_prohibition: disputed content stays withdrawn; the venue falls back to ordinary public space

roles.name: Event operations lead
qualifications: large-event safety and emergency planning experience
authority: continue, adjust or stop Global AI Activity Week routes
roles.absence_prohibition: no event segment may run; routes revert to daily public passage

roles.name: Independent reviewer
qualifications: no operational stake in the reviewed capability
able to reproduce the registered forward state from the submitted package
authority: reproduce claims, metrics and topology independently
publish accept / reject / accept_with_conditions decisions and open items
roles.absence_prohibition: no capability may advance from draft to sandbox or pilot without an independent acceptance decision
